teaser.en: Every leaf joint carries two thorns, one straight and one hooked: easy to catch on, hard to get free from.
teaser.sw: Kila kiungo cha jani kina miiba miwili, mmoja ulionyooka na mwingine wenye ndoano: ni rahisi kunaswa, ni vigumu kujinasua.

summary.en: Mgungune, the buffalo thorn, is a thorny bush tree related to the jujube, with zigzag twigs, glossy leaves and small red-brown fruits. It is widespread across Africa.
summary.sw: Mgungune, *buffalo thorn*, ni mti wa porini wenye miiba, jamaa wa mkunazi, wenye vijiti vinavyopinda kwa zigzag, majani yanayong'aa na matunda madogo ya rangi ya hudhurungi-nyekundu. Umeenea kote barani Afrika.

about.en:
*Mgungune* is a small to medium tree, often with a rounded crown and drooping branches. The twigs grow in a zigzag, and at each bend there are two thorns, one straight and pointing forward, the other short and hooked back. Once caught on them, it is hard to pull free.

The leaves are shiny, oval and slightly toothed, with three veins running from the base. Small yellow-green flowers cluster at the leaf bases, and the round fruits ripen from green to a reddish brown. The fruit has thin, mealy flesh around a hard stone.
about.sw:
*Mgungune* ni mti mdogo hadi wa wastani, mara nyingi wenye taji la mviringo na matawi yanayoning'inia. Vijiti vyake hukua kwa mtindo wa zigzag, na kwenye kila kona kuna miiba miwili, mmoja ulionyooka na unaoelekea mbele, na mwingine mfupi wenye ndoano unaoelekea nyuma. Ukishanaswa nayo, ni vigumu kujinasua.

Majani yanang'aa, yana umbo la yai na meno madogo pembeni, na mishipa mitatu inayotoka kwenye kitako. Maua madogo ya rangi ya manjano-kijani hujikusanya kwenye vitako vya majani, na matunda ya mviringo huiva kutoka kijani hadi hudhurungi-nyekundu. Tunda lina nyama nyembamba kama unga inayozunguka kokwa ngumu.

where.en: It grows in bushland, wooded grassland and along rivers and gullies, and it does well on dry and poor soils. It is found right across eastern and southern Africa, including the bush of the Kenya coast.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka, nyasi zenye miti na kando ya mito na makorongo, na hustawi vizuri kwenye udongo mkavu na usio na rutuba. Hupatikana kote mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika, ikiwemo misitu ya vichaka ya pwani ya Kenya.

uses.en: In many parts of Africa the fruit is eaten fresh or dried and ground into meal, and the leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine. Pakia records no specific Digo use.
uses.sw: Katika sehemu nyingi za Afrika tunda lake huliwa likiwa bichi au hukaushwa na kusagwa kuwa unga, na majani na mizizi hutumika katika tiba za jadi. Pakia harekodi matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mgungune* as the Digo name, with the English name 'buffalo thorn'. It belongs to the same genus as *mkunazi*, the Indian jujube, and as *Ziziphus robertsoniana*, which Pakia lists under the name *mng'ambo*. No Swahili name is given in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *mgungune* kama jina la Kidigo, pamoja na jina la Kiingereza *buffalo thorn*. Uko katika jenasi moja na *mkunazi*, mkunazi wa Kihindi, na *Ziziphus robertsoniana*, ambao Pakia anauorodhesha kwa jina *mng'ambo*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili linalotolewa katika vyanzo.

reason.en: Scutia myrtina, a thorny scrambler of the same family
reason.sw: Scutia myrtina, mmea unaotambaa wenye miiba wa familia hiyo hiyo

reason.en: Another thorny tree of the dry bush
reason.sw: Mgunga, mti mwingine wenye miiba wa nyika kavu
